title: Writing methods
description:
Complete the static methods in `Solution`:

```java
static boolean isPrime(int n)              // true for 2, 3, 5, 7, ...; false for anything below 2
static int gcd(int a, int b)               // greatest common divisor (Euclid's algorithm); gcd(0, 0) is 0
static int digitSum(long n)                // sum of the decimal digits, ignoring a minus sign
static double area(double radius)          // a circle
static double area(double width, double height)   // a rectangle (an overload)
static String repeat(String s, int times, String separator)   // "ab", 3, "-" gives "ab-ab-ab"
```

`isPrime` should only try divisors up to the square root of `n`. `gcd` works for negative numbers too and always returns a value of 0 or more.
hints: Write the loop condition as `(long) d * d <= n`: for `n` near `Integer.MAX_VALUE`, `d * d` would overflow an `int`.
Euclid: replace `(a, b)` with `(b, a % b)` until `b` is 0; then `a` is the answer.
